title: Detailed watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Main body of watering can -->
  <rect x="30" y="40" width="42" height="40" rx="6" fill="#e8432e"/>
  <rect x="33" y="43" width="36" height="34" rx="4" fill="#f25a45"/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <rect x="37" y="47" width="8" height="22" rx="4" fill="#ff7d6b" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Bottom rim -->
  <rect x="26" y="74" width="50" height="8" rx="4" fill="#c93020"/>
  <rect x="28" y="76" width="46" height="4" rx="2" fill="#e8432e"/>
  <!-- Top rim -->
  <rect x="26" y="36" width="50" height="8" rx="4" fill="#c93020"/>
  <rect x="28" y="38" width="46" height="4" rx="2" fill="#e8432e"/>
  <!-- Handle (arch on top) -->
  <path d="M38 38 Q38 12 66 12 Q82 12 82 30 L82 38" fill="none" stroke="#2e8b57" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M38 38 Q38 15 66 15 Q79 15 79 30 L79 38" fill="none" stroke="#3cb371" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d="M30 52 L10 28 L14 24 L34 46 Z" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <path d="M31 50 L13 29 L15 27 L33 47 Z" fill="#3cb371" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Spout tip / rose -->
  <ellipse cx="12" cy="26" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#c9b037" transform="rotate(-40 12 26)"/>
  <ellipse cx="12" cy="26" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#e8d44d" transform="rotate(-40 12 26)"/>
  <!-- Rose holes -->
  <circle cx="10" cy="24" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="23" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="24" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <circle cx="11" cy="27" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <circle cx="13" cy="28" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="27" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <circle cx="9" cy="28" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="30" r="0.8" fill="#8b7320"/>
  <!-- Decorative band on body -->
  <rect x="32" y="56" width="38" height="5" rx="2" fill="#c9b037"/>
  <rect x="32" y="58" width="38" height="2" rx="1" fill="#e8d44d"/>
  <!-- Water drops from spout -->
  <path d="M8 32 Q7 36 8 38 Q10 36 8 32 Z" fill="#4fc3f7"/>
  <path d="M14 34 Q13 38 14 40 Q16 38 14 34 Z" fill="#4fc3f7"/>
  <path d="M5 36 Q4 39 5 41 Q7 39 5 36 Z" fill="#81d4fa"/>
  <!-- Small handle attachment details -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="38" r="3" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="38" r="3" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#3cb371"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#3cb371"/>
</svg>
